title: The Diatessaron (Section 33)
breadcrumbs: Home > Fathers of the Church > The Diatessaron (Tatian) > Section 33

paragraphs.text: 1 [Arabic, p. 125] {{BIBLE:mar 11:19}} And when evening came, Jesus went forth outside of the city, he and his 2 disciples. {{BIBLE:mar 11:20}} And as they passed in the morning, the disciples saw that fig tree 3 withered away from its root. {{BIBLE:mat 21:20}} And they passed by, and said, How did the fig tree dry 4 up immediately? {{BIBLE:mar 11:21}} And Simon remembered, and said unto him, My Master, behold, 5 that fig tree which you cursed has dried up. {{BIBLE:mar 11:22}} And Jesus answered and said 6 unto them, Let there be in you the faith of God. {{BIBLE:mar 11:23}} Verily I say unto you, if you believe, and doubt not in your hearts, and assure yourselves that that will be which 7 ye say, you shall have what ye say. {{BIBLE:mat 21:21}} And if you say to this mountain, Remove, and 8 fall into the sea, it shall be. {{BIBLE:mat 21:22}} And all that you ask God in prayer, and believe, he 9, 10 will give you. {{BIBLE:luk 17:5}} And the apostles said unto our Lord, Increase our faith. {{BIBLE:luk 17:6}} He said unto them, If there be in you faith like a grain of mustard, you shall say to this fig tree, Be torn up, and be planted in the sea; and it will obey you. 11 {{BIBLE:luk 17:7}} Who of you has a servant driving a yoke of oxen or tending sheep, and if he 12 come from the field, will say unto him straightway, Go and sit down? {{BIBLE:luk 17:8}} Nay, he will say unto him, Make ready for me wherewith I may sup, and gird your waist, and serve me, till I eat and drink; and afterwards you shall eat and drink also. 13 {{BIBLE:luk 17:9}} Does that servant haply, who did what he was bid, receive his praise? I think 14 not. {{BIBLE:luk 17:10}} So ye also, when you have done all that you were bid, say, We are idle servants; what it was our duty to do, we have done.

15 {{BIBLE:mar 11:24}} For this reason I say unto you, Whatever ye pray and ask, believe that you 16 [Arabic, p. 126] receive, and you shall have. {{BIBLE:mar 11:25}} And when you stand to pray, forgive what is in your heart against any man; and your Father which is in heaven will 17 forgive you also your wrong-doings. {{BIBLE:mar 11:26}} But if you forgive not men their wrong-doings, neither will your Father forgive you also your wrong-doings.

18 {{BIBLE:luk 18:1}} And he spoke unto them a parable also, that they should pray at all times, and 19 not be slothful: {{BIBLE:luk 18:2}} There was a judge in a city, who feared not God, nor was ashamed 20 for men: {{BIBLE:luk 18:3}} and there was a widow in that city; and she came unto him, and said, 21 Avenge me of mine adversary. {{BIBLE:luk 18:4}} And he would not for a long time: but afterwards he said within himself, If of God I have no fear, and before men I have no shame; 22 {{BIBLE:luk 18:5}} yet because this widow vexes me, I will avenge her, that she come not at all times 23, 24 and annoy me. {{BIBLE:luk 18:6}} And our Lord said, Hear ye what the judge of injustice said. {{BIBLE:luk 18:7}} And shall not God still more do vengeance for his elect, who call upon him in the night 25 and in the day, and grant them respite? {{BIBLE:luk 18:8}} I say unto you, He will do vengeance for them speedily. Do you think the Son of man will come and find faith on the earth?

26, 27 {{BIBLE:mar 11:15}} And they came again to Jerusalem. {{BIBLE:luk 20:1}} And it came to pass, on one of the days, as Jesus was walking in the temple, and teaching the people, and preaching the 28 gospel, {{BIBLE:luk 20:2}} that the chief priests and the scribes with the elders came upon him, and said unto him, Tell us: {{BIBLE:mar 11:28}} By what power do you do this? And who gave you this 29 power to do that? And Jesus said unto them, I also will ask you one word, and if 30 ye tell me, I also shall tell you by what power I do that. {{BIBLE:mat 21:25}} The baptism of John, from 31 what place is it? From heaven or of men? {{BIBLE:mar 11:30}} Tell me. {{BIBLE:mat 21:25}} And they reflected within themselves, [Arabic, p. 127] and said, If we shall say unto him, From heaven; he will say unto 32 us, For what reason did ye not believe him? {{BIBLE:mat 21:26}} But if we shall say, Of men; 33 we fear that the people will stone us, all of them. And all of them were holding 34 to John, that he was a true prophet. {{BIBLE:mar 11:33}} They answered and said unto him, We know 35 not. {{BIBLE:mat 21:28}} Jesus said unto them, Neither tell I you also by what power I work. What do you think? A man had two sons; and he went to the first, and said unto him, My 36 son, go today, and till in the vineyard. {{BIBLE:mat 21:29}} And he answered and said, I do not wish 37 to: but finally he repented, and went. {{BIBLE:mat 21:30}} And he went to the other, and said unto 38 him likewise. {{BIBLE:mat 21:31}} And he answered and said, Yea, my lord: and went not. Which of these two did the will of his father? They said unto him, The first. Jesus said unto them, Verily I say unto you, The publicans and harlots go before you into 39 the kingdom of God. {{BIBLE:mat 21:32}} John came unto you in the way of righteousness, and you believed him not; but the publicans and harlots believed him; and you, not even when you saw, did ye repent at last, that you might believe in him.

40 {{BIBLE:mat 21:33}} Hear another parable: A man was a householder, and planted a vineyard, and surrounded it with a hedge, and dug in it a winepress, and built in it a tower, 41, 42 and gave it to husbandmen, and went to a distance for a long time. {{BIBLE:mar 12:34}} So when the time of the fruits came, he sent his servants unto the husbandmen, that they might 43 send him of the produce of his vineyard. {{BIBLE:mar 12:3}} And those husbandmen beat him, and 44 sent him away empty. {{BIBLE:mar 12:4}} And he sent unto them another servant also; and they 45 stoned him, and wounded him, and sent him away with shameful handling. {{BIBLE:mar 12:5}} And he sent again another; and they slew him. And he sent many other servants unto 46 them. {{BIBLE:mat 21:35}} And the husbandmen took his servants, and one they beat, and another they 47 stoned, and another they slew. {{BIBLE:mat 21:36}} So he sent again other servants more than the first; and 48 [Arabic, p. 128] they did likewise with them. {{BIBLE:luk 20:13}} So the owner of the vineyard said, What shall I do? I will send my beloved son: it may be they will see him and be 49, 50 ashamed. {{BIBLE:mar 12:6}} So at last he sent unto them his beloved son that he had. {{BIBLE:mat 21:38}} But the husbandmen, when they saw the son, said among themselves, This is the heir. 51, 52 {{BIBLE:luk 20:14}} And they said, We will slay him, and so the inheritance will be ours. {{BIBLE:mat 21:39}} So they took 53 him, and put him forth without the vineyard, and slew him. {{BIBLE:mat 21:40}} When then the lord 54 of the vineyard shall come, what will he do with those husbandmen? {{BIBLE:mat 21:41}} They said unto him, He will destroy them in the worst of ways, and give the vineyard to 55 other husbandmen, who will give him fruit in its season. {{BIBLE:mat 21:42}} Jesus said unto them, Have ye never read in the scripture,

The stone which the builders declared to be base,
{{BIBLE:luk 20:17}} The same came to be at the head of the corner:
56 {{BIBLE:mat 21:42}} From God was this,
And it is wonderful in our eyes?

57 {{BIBLE:mat 21:43}} Therefore I say unto you, The kingdom of God shall be taken from you, and 58 given to a people that will produce fruit. {{BIBLE:mat 21:44}} And whosoever falls on this stone shall be broken in pieces: but on whomsoever it falls, it will grind him to 59 powder. {{BIBLE:mat 21:45}} And when the chief priests and the Pharisees heard his parables, they 60 perceived that it was concerning them he spoke. {{BIBLE:mat 21:46}} And they sought to seize him; and they feared the multitude, because they were holding to him as the prophet.
